evals.prompt: /master-skill I have a new idea: an app that helps small cafés in Saigon swap leftover pastries with each other before closing. I want to know if it's worth it. Where do I start?
evals.expected_output: Asks ONE question at a time (doesn't jump to advice), then once confirmed routes to the Idea → Validate playbook: ycofficehour first with a pass/fail number that fits a small B2B audience (a conversation number such as '5 of 10 café owners agree to a trial', not only a landing-page %), concierge test considered. Ends with the bold next-action line.

evals.prompt: which skill should i use to review our client's new website before launch? they want a report AND want us to fix the issues, the site is built in next.js and Thanh has the repo

evals.prompt: Mình vừa phỏng vấn 8 khách hàng của Rally, có transcript rồi. Giờ nên dùng skill nào để tổng hợp?
